_comment: Ynet titles from 11.11.2026 plus 10 synthetic tokenizer cases, with the expected result of server/news-filter.json under docs/content/news-filter-reference.py. Updated 11.11.2026: (1) outer quotes stripped before matching, inner gershayim and trailing geresh kept; (2) prefixes stripped only in valid order ו?(ש|כש|מש)?[בכלמ]?ה?; (3) risky short stems moved to exact words. The JS port must reproduce every 'keep' value.
